_comment: The assembly canary: a small, genuine theorem through a program object (`Phi`, the blueprint's `def:standard-normal-cdf`), with its proof. `scripts/assembly-smoke.sh` emits it through the real emitter, places it with the real applier and runs this pack's whole assembly recipe on it, then STOPS before the push. It is never contributed: once it were, it would be a duplicate statement and the canary would (correctly) go red.

issue.title: assembly canary: the central probability of the standard normal

intent.docstring: For every real `x`, the standard normal distribution function satisfies `Phi x - Phi (-x) = 2 * Phi x - 1`: the mass of `[-x, x]` in terms of `Phi x` alone.
intent.title: The central probability of the standard normal
